question_declaration.question: Can the unchanged R10F physical route preserve the launcher's observed self-or-descendant identity relationship, express V6 ownership in the canonical observation domain, and publish exactly one primary report without corrupting its typed return, while retaining the exact input and response of a refused collection?

diagnosed_boundaries.launch: The historical launcher permits a checked self-or-descendant engine process, but both final consumers require equality. The exact retained baseline IDs are 205036 and 198844; the active IDs are 65340 and 67812.
diagnosed_boundaries.ownership: The R10F no-actuation producer admits recovery_v6 and the native observation collector copies it into a Rust enum whose domain is none, recovery, stance. The retained refusal names recovery_v6.
diagnosed_boundaries.publication: The report writer emits a marker string and a dictionary into one success stream. The full-pair caller then receives two objects and its strict .ok access throws. Frozen statement replay reproduces that same error.

launch_relationship.rule: Add an explicitly versioned R10F launch-relationship receipt from the live check already performed before accepting the ready-to-terminate receipt. Retain distinct console and engine PIDs. Both final consumers must validate the same exact relationship and enclosing source bindings instead of demanding equality.

canonical_ownership.rule: Use a versioned no-actuation application producer that retains the orchestration owner separately and maps it to the canonical observation owner before the actual typed collection call. Keep the V6 controller ID and source memory exact; do not teach the canonical Rust enum to accept orchestration aliases.

publication.rule: Separate machine-readable report publication from the typed supervisor return. The writer must return exactly one dictionary; each actual caller publishes one marker for the same primary report and selects the proper exit path. Exercise complete early-invalid and full-pair callers, not just extracted tail statements.

exact_failed_collection_retention.rule: Add an explicit versioned opt-in at the R10F native collection serialization boundary. Serialize once with the existing authoritative transport, pass that exact string once to the compiled collector, and retain its UTF-8 text, byte length and SHA-256 with the exact returned response text and decoded refusal. Carry this receipt and named input source links through the route refusal, worker abort, child envelope and supervisor before cleanup.

required_zero_world_coverage.requirement: Reopen the exact sealed diagnosis, immutable closure, all 17 retained files and eight frozen sources; reproduce its 39 controls and its limited statement/predicate results without substituting successor consumers for historical evidence.

Exercise the versioned production relationship producer on self and a real owned nonphysics descendant process, and on absent, unrelated, nonpositive, duplicate/cyclic, truncated, over-depth and unreadable chains. Any helper process is hidden, bounded, owned and joined; no Godot physical worker, model or scene is launched.

Feed complete source-shaped launch receipts through the actual early supervisor validator, PowerShell paired consumer and independent Python closer. Include equal and unequal PIDs, swapped roots/workers, nonces, runtime images, ready receipts, stale hashes, Boolean/fractional PID fields, missing proof and tampered termination/health/exit evidence. No validator may accept arbitrary unequal PIDs.

Exercise both production no-actuation callers through the versioned producer, actual observation/request construction, authoritative serialization and unchanged compiled Rust collector with complete synthetic source inputs. Cover none/null ID and recovery_v6/exact V6 ID, wrong/missing IDs, unknown owners, stale mapping/application/memory bindings and every actual native refusal. A permissive SDK stub or source-string check alone cannot qualify this path.

Compare old and new no-actuation physical command fields, all eight motor states and caps, exact V6 memory and unchanged controller inputs. Any allowed metadata/hash differences must be attributable only to the declared versioned ownership mapping; old records are never corrected.

Invoke the actual complete report writer and early-invalid/full-pair caller paths with complete source-only child fixtures. Require one primary file, one marker, one typed result and the declared exit status for complete valid success, complete valid behavior-negative, invalid baseline, invalid active, paired invalid and publication/error-path failures. Preserve the primary file if a later exception occurs.

Send a deliberate complete synthetic canonical collection refusal through the actual compiled ABI exactly once. Verify byte-for-byte request and response retention, matching lengths/hashes and source links in actual route failure, worker abort, envelope, supervisor and independent consumer. Exercise malformed response, serializer/precollection refusal and absent/tampered retention without a physics read, duplicate collection or controller advance.

Exercise complete production-shaped worker-to-envelope-to-pair-to-closer composition for valid resumed, all seven source-proven no-resume negatives, invalid/incomplete active and missing peer. Keep engine-health failure, incomplete collection and absent evidence invalid; no behavioral gate can pass from missing output.

Preserve the v2 observed-contact-cycle evaluator, both complete retained walking replays, 27 fixed gate names and thresholds, exact native terminal/source number-kind checks, correct interaction start-receipt binding, all seven no-resume branches, L13 pre-parse/host-target/ledger controls, L12 handoffs, L11 release, and earlier process-isolation controls.

Integrate the exact new design and all changed producers, consumers and tests in a distinct complete recursive source manifest. Feed actual newly produced component and qualification receipts into the actual enclosing readers, materializer, supervisor and closer. Corrupt each source/runtime/design/dependency binding; do not qualify a smaller synthetic shape than the production writer produces.

Run component, complete development and later official qualification serially. Every model construction, physical world, scene insertion, native physics read/write and solver-step counter is zero. The pure compiled SDK and nonphysics host process checks do not authorize or imply physical execution.
